body.heading: Where in the world is Cambodia?
paragraphs: Cambodia is a country in Southeast Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Cambodia is Phnom Penh.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Cambodia is Khmer.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Cambodia is the Cambodian riel.

body.heading: How big is Cambodia?
paragraphs: Cambodia covers about 181,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Japan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world — a stone temple-city of towers and moats built 900 years ago, best seen glowing at sunrise.
Near Angkor Wat, giant stone faces smile from the Bayon temple, and at Ta Prohm, enormous tree roots pour over the ruins like melted wax.
